## Public documentation update

Describe what project(s) and milestone(s) changed.

## Evidence and limitations

Which outcomes are verified? Which remain planned, simulated, or untested?

## Pre-publication checks

- [ ] Dates, versions, technical claims and verification levels are accurate
- [ ] No private chats, credentials, private infrastructure details, or unlicensed media
- [ ] Project links and MDX frontmatter are valid
- [ ] Content checker and Astro build passed (or limitations explained)
- [ ] Public disclosure scope is reviewed
